declare -- modified for win7. Also CLIENT_WIN_API_ENVIRONMENT.GET_TEMP_DIRECTORY does not work for win 7

 l_file_path VARCHAR2(200);

 l_image_Ext VARCHAR2(10);
 --lv_query VARCHAR2(2000);
BEGIN 
 
 :global.user_home := webutil_clientinfo.get_system_property('user.home');

-- First part - File selector button code;
 declare
 l_filename varchar2(2000);
 l_filesize VARCHAR2(1000);
 begin
 :global.user_home := webutil_clientinfo.get_system_property('user.home'); -- IM:9426
 l_filename := client_get_file_name(directory_name => :global.user_home
 ,file_name => null
 ,file_filter => null
 ,message => null
 ,dialog_type => null
 ,select_file => null
 );
 -- User can click on ReadImage Button (image is displayed on screen), and then can mistakenly click on the ReadImage button and cancel it. At this point, we do not want a null
 -- file name to be assosicated with ctrl.file_name field. This will mess up the second part of read image code below.
 IF l_filename IS NOT NULL THEN 
 :ctrl.file_name := l_filename;
 :ctrl.s_file_name := SUBSTR(l_filename, INSTR(l_filename,'\', -1)+1);
 END IF;

/* IF l_filename IS NOT NULL THEN
 l_filesize := to_char(webutil_file.file_size(l_filename))||' bytes';
 message(l_filesize);pause;
 END IF;
*/
 end;
-------------------------------------


 
 
-- Second part - read image code;
 IF :ctrl.s_file_name IS NOT NULL THEN
 
 l_image_Ext := LOWER( SUBSTR(:ctrl.s_file_name, INSTR(:ctrl.s_file_name, '.')+1));
 
 IF l_image_Ext NOT IN ('png', 'jpeg', 'jpg', 'tif', 'tiff') THEN
 show_error('21214');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 
 /*
 -- MLT 895 (unable to display png image using forms buitin. Tried using LAF, and was able to display png image as well. 
 -- But, could not use LAF as we need latest version of LAF to also allow display of stored images in db table.
 */
 
 /*
 -- Below line is used to display image file from client directory.
 Set_Custom_Property('LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN21',1,'IMG_NEW','img,25,225,728,115, '); -- this works (verified size and it is able to read image file to this item)
 Set_Custom_Property('LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN21',1,'IMG_READIMGFILE','img,c:/LifeTrak/WS-BloodCenters.png');
 */
 
 /* -- another way to display image file from client directory. 
 Set_Custom_Property('LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN21', 1, 'ADD_IMAGE','1,c:/LifeTrak/WS-BloodCenters.png,25,225,1,300,-1');
 */
 
 /* Use below code to retrieve the image from db, but this requires latest version of LAF (1.6 onwards)
 lv_query := 'select question_desc_blob from multi_lang_converter where lang_code = ''' || :ctrl.lang_code
 || ''' and question_code = ''' || :ctrl.question_code || '''';
 
 PKG_LOOK_AND_FEEL.Read_Image('LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN','img' , lv_query); 
 */ 
 
 /* Add this line in initialise_window to clear
 Set_Custom_Property('LAF_BLOCK.LAF_BEAN21', 1, 'CLEAR','');
 */
 
 
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '25'; -- MLT 895 (suppress read image errors)
 if l_image_Ext in ('png') then
 SHOW_ERROR('23103');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 client_image.read_image_file(:ctrl.file_name,'JFIF' , 'MULTI_LANG_CONVERTER.QUESTION_DESC_BLOB');
 end if;
 :SYSTEM.MESSAGE_LEVEL := '0';
 END IF;
 --ELSE -- User can cancel out the file selector window; no need to check if image is selected, forms will insert empty_blob();
 --SHOW_ERROR('0080', ' File Name');
 --check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
---------------- 
EXCEPTION
 WHEN FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE THEN
 RAISE; 
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 MESSAGE('Err : In Read Image button ' || SQLERRM);
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: VALIDATE_EFF_TERM_DATES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(:banner.hdr_date) then
 show_error('3115');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UPLOAD_DB
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE UPLOAD_DB(lang_code_in IN VARCHAR2, question_code_in IN VARCHAR2) IS
 l_success boolean;
 c_table_name VARCHAR2(50):= 'multi_lang_converter';
 c_column_name VARCHAR2(50) := 'question_desc_blob';
 c_where_clause VARCHAR2(500) := 'lang_code = ''' || lang_code_in || '''' || ' and question_code = ''' || question_code_in ||'''';
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 

 ---
/*
 INSERT INTO multi_lang_converter(question_code, lang_code, question_desc_blob, insert_date, insert_user, eff_date, term_date, program_id, audit_key)
 VALUES (question_code_in, lang_code_in, null, sysdate, :banner.user_id, :multi_lang_converter.eff_date, :multi_lang_converter.term_date, :banner.prog_name, null);
*/
 
 :system.message_level := '10';
 post;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 
 l_success := webutil_file_transfer.Client_To_DB_with_progress
 (clientFile => :ctrl.file_name
 ,tableName => c_table_name
 ,columnName => c_column_name
 ,whereClause => c_where_clause
 ,progressTitle => 'Upload to Database in progress'
 ,progressSubTitle=> 'Please wait'
 ,asynchronous => false
 ,callbackTrigger => null
 );
 if l_success
 then
 message('File uploaded successfully into the Database');
 else
 message('File upload to Database failed');
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others
 then
 message('File upload failed: '||sqlerrm);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_QUES_CODE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
SELECT seq, image, qcode, qdesc
from
(
WITH mlc_lang AS (
SELECT mlc.question_code, length(question_desc_blob) len
 FROM multi_lang_converter mlc
WHERE mlc.lang_code = :CTRL.LANG_CODE
),
ques AS (
SELECT 1 seq, vhq.question_code qcode, vhq.question_description qdesc
 FROM valid_hh_questions vhq
 WHERE SYSDATE BETWEEN vhq.eff_date AND nvl(vhq.term_date, SYSDATE+1)
UNION
SELECT 2 seq, SUBSTR(description, 0, INSTR(description, ' ')-1) qcode, SUBSTR(description, INSTR(description, ' ')+1) qdesc
FROM valid_master_codes
WHERE code_type = 'MULAN'
AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 1)
)
SELECT q.seq, q.qcode, q.qdesc, DECODE(m.len, NULL, 'N', 'Y') Image
 FROM ques q, mlc_lang m
WHERE q.qcode = m.question_code(+)
)
ORDER BY SEQ ASC, qcode ASC
